correctness.rationale: Brownian increments conditional on independent renewal durations have variance 2Dm and fourth cumulant 12D²Var(T). Bilateral stationary AR(1) expansion gives its second/fourth cumulants. Conditional quadratic regression establishes Cov(Y_j²,Y_{j+h}²)=a^{2h}Var(Y_0²), yielding exact finite-n work mean/variance and asymptotic variance. Stationary ergodic martingale-difference decomposition proves the CLT. Triangular-array invariance plus normalized stationary-initial Lindeberg limit yields OU paths and their squared-integral work; Wick calculation gives the stated crossover variance. The included code independently checks six Monte Carlo moment cases and three weak-reset moment limits.

value.rationale: A fixed-mean work rate does not determine energetic risk. Exact finite-n fluctuations distinguish duration randomness from long-range dependence due to incomplete erasure. Their singular loss of self-averaging and universal non-Gaussian integrated-OU crossover are physically motivated by the mean-only partial-reset work paper and identify the correct event-count scale n(1-a²). The rate 4/ε is not inferred from a marginal Gaussian limit and is accompanied by explicit distributional convergence.
